excerpt: Stream your movies, TV shows, and music from your own server.
description: Jellyfin is a free and open-source media server that organizes and streams your personal media library to virtually any device. It supports movies, TV shows, music, live TV, DVR, and user accounts without requiring a subscription.

excerpt: Manage all your indexers from one place.
description: Prowlarr centralizes indexer management for applications like Sonarr, Radarr, Lidarr, and Readarr. Configure your indexers once and automatically sync them across your media automation stack.

excerpt: A lightweight web interface for managing and viewing files.
description: Qui is a lightweight web application from the autobrr project that provides a simple interface for browsing and managing files through your browser.

excerpt: A lightweight BitTorrent client with a powerful web interface.
description: qBittorrent is an open-source BitTorrent client that provides fast downloads, RSS support, search plugins, bandwidth scheduling, and a modern web UI for managing torrents from anywhere.

excerpt: Monitor your system's performance in real time.
description: Glances is a cross-platform system monitoring tool that displays CPU, memory, disk, network, process, and container statistics through an intuitive web interface or terminal dashboard.

excerpt: Monitor your services and get notified when they go offline.
description: Uptime Kuma is a self-hosted uptime monitoring solution that checks the availability of websites, APIs, servers, and services. It includes status pages, notifications, and response time tracking.

excerpt: Host your own Minecraft server in minutes.
description: The itzg Minecraft Server container makes it easy to run a customizable Minecraft server with support for Vanilla, Paper, Spigot, Fabric, Forge, and more.

excerpt: Manage your Docker containers from an easy-to-use web interface.
description: Portainer is a lightweight management interface for Docker that lets you create, manage, monitor, and troubleshoot containers, images, networks, and volumes through a web browser.

excerpt: Easily manage reverse proxies, SSL certificates, and domain names.
description: Nginx Proxy Manager provides a simple web interface for managing Nginx reverse proxies and SSL certificates. It makes it easy to securely expose self-hosted applications using custom domain names and automatic Let's Encrypt certificates.

excerpt: Automatically update your running Docker containers.
description: Watchtower monitors your running Docker containers and automatically updates them when new images are available. It can help keep a homelab up to date without manually pulling new images and recreating containers.

excerpt: Monitor the uptime and availability of your services.
description: Uptime Kuma is a self-hosted monitoring tool that lets you monitor websites, servers, Docker containers, and other services. It supports HTTP, TCP, Ping, DNS, and other monitoring methods with notifications for downtime.

excerpt: Monitor your server's CPU, memory, disk, network, and system resources.
description: Glances is a cross-platform system monitoring tool that provides an overview of CPU, memory, disk, network, processes, and other system resources through a web interface.

excerpt: View and monitor Docker container logs in real time.
description: Dozzle is a lightweight web-based Docker container log viewer. It provides a simple interface for viewing and following logs from running containers in real time without needing to use the command line.

excerpt: Create a customizable dashboard for your homelab services.
description: Homepage is a highly customizable self-hosted dashboard for organizing and accessing your homelab services. It can display service status, system information, bookmarks, and integrations from a single web interface.

excerpt: Build a customizable dashboard for all your self-hosted services.
description: Dashy is a self-hosted dashboard that provides a customizable interface for organizing links and applications across your homelab. It supports icons, status checks, authentication, themes, and numerous integrations.

excerpt: Block ads and trackers across your entire network with DNS.
description: Pi-hole is a network-wide DNS sinkhole that blocks advertisements, trackers, and other unwanted domains for devices connected to your network. It also provides a web interface for viewing DNS activity and managing blocklists.

excerpt: Block ads and trackers with a network-wide DNS server.
description: AdGuard Home is a network-wide DNS server that blocks advertisements, trackers, and malicious domains. It provides detailed DNS statistics, filtering controls, and a web interface for managing your network's DNS traffic.
